Message.MsgText: Close IdML Function Component accepts only a SyncWeave Entry as input.

Explanation.p: At the beginning of the Function Component's execution cycle the input data passed was not a SyncWeave Entry.

OperatorResponse.p: Close IdML Function Component expects only a SyncWeave Entry as input. Check the AL logic and try again.

Message.MsgText: The book 'book name' is already closed or has never been created.

Explanation.p: Close IdML Function Component always attempts to close its configured book. If its is executed repeatedly in the Flow of the AssemblyLine for the same book name, an error will occur.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the AL logic and try again.

Message.MsgText: Close IdML Function Component will work with book: 'book name'.
The name of the currently used book 'book name' has been overridden to 'new name'.
Close IdML Function Component closed book 'book name'.

Explanation.p: The specified parameter is needed by the Close IdML Function Component and must be provided.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a value for this parameter.
